summary: Serve Robotics Inc. filed an 8-K reporting the termination of its Controlled Equity Offering Agreement with Cantor Fitzgerald and other agents, effective May 7, 2026. The prior sales agreement allowed up to $150 million in share sales; 7,716,935 shares were sold for gross proceeds of ~$91.2 million. No termination penalties apply. Separately, the filing includes unaudited pro forma financials for the acquisition of Diligent Robotics closed in January 2026. This is a routine contractual termination with no special situation; no deal terms or catalysts for event-driven analysis.
